name: Bob Evans Farms - Lima OH Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (refrigerated sides - mashed potatoes & macaroni & cheese; former Kettle Creations facility)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck driveway off Commerce Pkwy crosses a chain-link perimeter fence; a gate opening is visible in the fence line at satellite z21 (~40.6953, -84.0952). The whole trailer yard is fenced. Truck gate confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure visible beside the gate in satellite z20/z21 or in Street View (2024-10) from the road. Street View coverage does not extend up the private drive; absence of a booth at the fence crossing is the basis for the call. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack -> remote/unmanned check-in implied (sliding gate / call-box / app).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Long paved drive and a wide internal apron between the gate and the dock bank give ample inside-the-fence staging room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach is a long deep drive that can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large dock bank on the south building face with ~12-15 trailers backed in plus additional doors; estimated ~28 doors total. 25-50 band; exact count uncertain from overhead angles.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple dedicated trailer-storage lots on the NE and SE of the property, full of parked trailers without tractors; well over 50 trailer stalls visible.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots clearly present on the NE and SE corners.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the south edge of Lima near I-75, bordered by farm fields; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~55 trailers visible in the imagery; lots could hold ~70. Estimate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large ~150,000 sq ft connected plant building (the adjacent Logoplaste building to the west is a separate company, excluded).
